# anthropic_workspace_member (Resource)

Grants an organization member a role in a workspace.

Requires `admin_api_key` or `oauth_token`.

Organization admins and billing members hold their workspace access implicitly and cannot be managed here. `workspace_billing` is inherited from the organization role and cannot be assigned.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anthropic_user" "jane" {
  email = "jane@example.com"
}

resource "anthropic_workspace_member" "jane_production" {
  workspace_id   = anthropic_workspace.production.id
  user_id        = data.anthropic_user.jane.id
  workspace_role = "workspace_developer"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `user_id` (String) User id (`user_...`).
- `workspace_id` (String) Workspace id (`wrkspc_...`).
- `workspace_role` (String) One of `workspace_admin`, `workspace_developer`, `workspace_restricted_developer`, `workspace_user`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite id `workspace_id/user_id`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import id is workspace_id/user_id
terraform import anthropic_workspace_member.jane_production wrkspc_01ExampleWorkspaceId000000/user_01ExampleUserId0000000000
```
